objective: Test whether the 11,602 candidate-only residual IDs are represented in Chen et al.'s separately published Table 6 suspected-variable catalogue.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The record contains Table2 (ZTF Variables Catalog) and Table6 (ZTF Suspected Variables Catalog). The Table6 archive MD5 is fcad26b036c8dbee29f6d868fecc9697.
The CDS mirror describes table3.dat as the ZTF suspected variables catalog with 1,381,527 rows and an ID column.
The public SNAD mirror imports Table2 and Table6 separately from Zenodo and defines an ID field for Table6; it is a catalogue mirror, not the original CPVS selection implementation.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: CPVS raw SNR evidence artifact, workflow run 43525513465
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The allowlisted compact evidence artifact contains SourceID and ZTF name for the 11,602 candidate-only residuals.

baseline.description: No production selector, model, benchmark or v0.2.0 artifact is changed. This is an external-catalogue overlap diagnostic only.

correctness.before: No object-level overlap comparison with Chen Table6 was recorded.
correctness.after: 0 of 11,602 unique candidate-only residual IDs occur in the checksum-pinned Table 6 suspected-variable catalogue (1,381,527 unique Table 6 IDs).

reproducibility.before: No pinned Table6 overlap report existed.
reproducibility.after: Zenodo Table6 archive MD5 fcad26b036c8dbee29f6d868fecc9697; member SHA-256 f1b51a6be353d8712eba626e12c57bb3c5b0900c2435210f088d65f9db32c6af; input raw-evidence run 43525513465; report SHA-256 b5a1eafd7b99d95dc31b627f9132a775d0ef9fc71efd62052a5b74b64ab2c28e; artifact digest sha256:687dde745d22212dfe74e05cf604b16738aeb566aa356ee69eb186a19b0ec743.

evidence: Table 6 workflow run 43538253256 completed successfully on revision ddd4f12e78da805d915792e49ac687aa870030b0.
Zenodo archive MD5 and decompressed member SHA-256/size/CRC were verified.
Table 6 contained 1,381,527 records and unique IDs; no duplicates were found.
All 11,602 candidate-only residuals were parsed as unique SourceID and ZTF ID; exact intersection with Table 6 was zero.
The deterministic tests passed in the successful workflow.
The JSON report and TSV output hashes are recorded in Think Tank Session 08.

root_causes: The 11,602 residuals have zero overlap with Table 6. Their original Chen/Chan selection-stage cause remains unknown.
limitations: Table 6 is a separate suspected-variable catalogue; zero overlap rules out only this cross-catalogue explanation.
This diagnostic does not reconstruct the original candidate selector or the Chan et al. Table 4 membership logic.

findings: Table 6 is a separately published suspected-variable catalogue with 1,381,527 unique IDs.
None of the 11,602 candidate-only residual IDs occur in Table 6.
The Table 6 overlap test is a reproducible negative result; it is not a valid production membership filter.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not use Table 6 overlap as a production filter.
Keep CPVS root cause NOT_PROVEN until the original published membership pipeline is reconstructed and full-parent comparison is complete.
Keep PR #285 Draft and issue #170 Open.
